manifests.deploymentYaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: orders-risk-worker
  namespace: dagents-demo
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: orders-risk-worker
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: orders-risk-worker
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: main
        image: ghcr.io/dagents/orders-risk-worker:demo
        args:
        - "--pipeline=orders-risk-demo"
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 8080
        env:
        - name: APP_ENV
          value: "demo"
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 250m
            memory: 256Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 1
            memory: 1Gi
manifests.serviceYaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: orders-risk-worker
  namespace: dagents-demo
spec:
  selector:
    app: orders-risk-worker
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 8080
    targetPort: 8080
manifests.configMapYaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: orders-risk-worker-config
  namespace: dagents-demo
data:
  component-kind: "Deployment"
  image: "ghcr.io/dagents/orders-risk-worker:demo"
